completion_decisions: The target package contains the 3-5-6-1 ANN wake surrogate, its from-scratch training lifecycle, joint layout/hub-height GA and all eight named E/C cases; generic GA citations are not separate target baselines.

No paper-linked source, Shiren array or trained weight asset was located; the private training array is replaced by deterministic stratified samples from the paper and recovered predecessor equations on the stated 0.01D/1D lattice.
Both direct model predecessors were legally recovered through Elsevier API and supply flow conservation, wake radius, downstream velocity, expansion and RSS semantics omitted from the target summary.
The target omits Shiren calibration constants; source-supported C=5.15 and onshore expansion 0.075 are isolated completions rather than author settings.

The paper states 1e-6 as its training goal. The proxy-data implementation trains for the paper maximum 1000 epochs and reports whether that goal is reached; H5 does not manufacture author-equivalent accuracy.

The paper's cost text conflicts with its USD/kW tables; minimizing total installed cost divided by total power is the registered direction. The cited curve starts at 60 m, so the declared curve is linearly extrapolated to the allowed 45 m lower bound.
The target omits GA details and repeat count; a population-64 real-coded completion and the platform 25-repeat rule are recorded field by field.
Teacher generation, deterministic gradient chunks and GA population evaluation use persistent full-core execution without changing one/all-core scientific trajectories.

paper.title: Wind farm layout and hub height optimization with a novel wake model

paper_source_conflicts: The target describes Cost of Power once as total power divided by total cost but minimizes and reports total cost divided by total power in USD/kW.
The cited installed-cost plot starts at 60 m while the optimization permits hub heights down to 45 m.
The target applies a three-coordinate ANN trained around a 65 m reference turbine to variable source and receiver heights without publishing the exact coordinate transformation.
The target reports 838 and 1017 convergence generations only for E4 and C4 and omits the other GA stopping rules.

scope.claim_boundary: academic declared reproduction of every named paper case and the paper/cited equations; not author code, private Shiren data, author-trained weights, exact GA, exact cost curve or numerical replay

constraints_and_repair.authority: target Eq. 6 and Section 4.1.2 plus declared completion
constraints_and_repair.resolution: 2 km square, at least 5D horizontal spacing, [45,85] m heights; candidate mutations are accepted only when feasible and otherwise revert

decision_variables.resolution: 30 labeled turbine genes, each with real-valued x, y and hub height; each case freezes the variables stated by the paper

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: real-valued 90-variable chromosome canonicalized by north-to-south then west-to-east turbine order

initialization.authority: target random-first-population statement plus declared feasible completion
initialization.resolution: paper aligned 5x6 layout is retained as one seed individual; other layouts use feasible coordinate perturbations and independently sampled bounded heights

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: maximum/mean/minimum and total power, height-dependent installed cost and USD/kW for 25 independent repeats of all eight named cases

objective_and_direction.resolution: maximize total power for E cases; minimize installed cost divided by total power for C cases

paper_native_cases.resolution: E1-E4 and C1-C4 are all registered; C1 and C3 retain the target's explicit aliases of E1 and E3

parameters.authority: target Sections 2.2 and 4 plus recovered direct predecessors
parameters.resolution: D=77 m, reference hub=65 m, 12.7 m/s, rated=1513 kW, cut-in/rated/cut-out=3/11/25 m/s, C=5.15 and onshore expansion=0.075 completions

stopping_and_physical_fes.authority: target E4/C4 generation reports plus declared family completion
stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: 838 generations and 53696 FEs for energy/E3-alias optimization; 1017 generations and 65152 FEs for cost-variable cases; one FE for fixed E1/C1

training_and_inference_lifecycle.authority: target Section 2.2 and recovered analytical teacher equations
training_and_inference_lifecycle.resolution: from-scratch 3-5-6-1 sigmoid-hidden ANN, deterministic 0.01D/1D teacher sampling, 70/15/15 split, maximum 1000 epochs and 1e-6 stopping target; inference uses independent point queries with physical wake-boundary masking

update_order.authority: target generic GA phases plus declared completion
update_order.resolution: binary tournament, arithmetic/uniform crossover, bounded Gaussian mutation, feasibility accept-or-revert, full offspring evaluation, deterministic parent-plus-offspring best-64 survival

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.authority: target Eqs. 1-5, recovered predecessor equations and Figs. 2/22
wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: log inflow, flux-conserving 3-D Gaussian teacher, ANN deficit, RSS multiple wakes, 13-point cube-mean rotor speed, turbine curve and declared installed-cost interpolation/extrapolation

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: one constant north-wind condition at 12.7 m/s and log-law vertical shear; no stochastic wind sampling
